header: The server side of the PAX admin panel (step 64a): here I use the database through the application's OWN connection (never the language model's read-only client), the logged-in person, and the one-word decision the omnibar needs ("is this person allowed to open the editor?").

symbols.name: nameOfTicket
symbols.sig: export async function nameOfTicket(ds: DataSource, ticket: string | null | undefined): Promise<string | null>
doc: The name of an employee from the people directory, by ticket; null when there is none or the read fails. The name is only shown, never decided on.

symbols.name: sessionActor
symbols.sig: export async function sessionActor(ds: DataSource): Promise<Actor | null>
doc: The logged-in person: the ticket comes from the session and the name from the people directory (the audit line carries both). Null when nobody is logged in.

symbols.name: authorityForTicket
symbols.sig: export async function authorityForTicket(ds: DataSource, ticket: string | null | undefined): Promise<Authority | null>
doc: For the omnibar: HOD, delegate, or null for this ticket. A failing read means null, because I never open the editor on doubt.
